change: Replace two final simpa-only conclusions by direct exact terms; Nat.zero_add occurs only in the boundedness proof, not either result type.
old:
· simpa only [initialState, rootControl, Nat.zero_add] using
      executeOld fuel rootControl initialState 0 (by omega) (.refl _ _) inputs
  · intro used rest current bounded actual
    simpa only [initialState, Nat.zero_add] using
      traceOld used rootControl initialState rest current actual 0 (.refl _ _)
        (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using bounded)
new:
· exact executeOld fuel rootControl initialState 0 (by omega) (.refl _ _) inputs
  · intro used rest current bounded actual
    exact traceOld used rootControl initialState rest current actual 0 (.refl _ _)
      (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using bounded)
